findingsFixed: Reject partial scholarship expectation configuration rather than silently omit checks.
Roundtrip scholarship provider and school/program/source scopes through JSON API.
Assert visible tuition/accommodation/insurance values within the corresponding detail rows.
Bind scholarship label helper to frozen support pins only for changed scholarship scopes.
regressions: Whole held mixed batch makes no writes or reservation.
Failed snapshot permanently reserves batch and cannot automatically replay.
Reused canonical source mutation rejected before writes.
Legacy programme-only smoke manifest shape and source support list preserved.
Positive pinned scholarship expectation succeeds; modified award rejected.
Partial and inconsistent scholarship expectations rejected.
All public locales display eligibility and exact coverage rows.
limitations: Evidence consumer verifies capture integrity and quote presence; independent reviewer remains responsible for semantic entailment of every amount, scope and eligibility claim.
Local snapshot writer is per-file atomic with guarded rollback, not a cross-file database transaction; failed operations require reconciliation.
No website smoke, deploy, canonical write, Git operation, authentication access or cloud write performed in this review.
